text.2:60: And when Moses asked for water for his people, We said: Smite with thy staff the rock. And there gushed out therefrom twelve springs (so that) each tribe knew their drinking-place. Eat and drink of that which Allah hath provided, and do not act corruptly, making mischief in the earth.
text.4:28: Allah would make the burden light for you, for man was created weak.
text.7:82: And the answer of his people was only that they said (one to another): Turn them out of your township. They are folk, forsooth, who keep pure.
text.7:160: We divided them into twelve tribes, nations; and We inspired Moses, when his people asked him for water, saying: Smite with thy staff the rock! And there gushed forth therefrom twelve springs, so that each tribe knew their drinking-place. And we caused the white cloud to overshadow them and sent down for them the manna and the quails (saying): Eat of the good things wherewith we have provided you. They wronged Us not, but they were wont to wrong themselves.
text.10:12: And if misfortune touch a man he crieth unto Us, (while reclining) on his side, or sitting or standing, but when We have relieved him of the misfortune he goeth his way as though he had not cried unto Us because of a misfortune that afflicted him. Thus is what they do made (seeming) fair unto the prodigal.
text.11:9: And if we cause man to taste some mercy from Us and afterward withdraw it from him, lo! he is despairing, thankless.
text.12:5: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.
text.14:34: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.
text.15:26: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
text.16:4: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
text.17:11: Man prayeth for evil as he prayeth for good; for man was ever hasty.
text.17:13: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.
text.17:53: Tell My bondmen to speak that which is kindlier. Lo! the devil soweth discord among them. Lo! the devil is for man an open foe.
text.17:67: And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.
text.17:71: On the day when We shall summon all men with their record, whoso is given his book in his right hand - such will read their book and they will not be wronged a shred.
text.17:83: And when We make life pleasant unto man, he turneth away and is averse; and when ill toucheth him he is in despair.
text.17:100: Say (unto them): If ye possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Lord, ye would surely hold them back for fear of spending, for man was ever grudging.
text.18:54: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all manner of similitudes, but man is more than anything contentious.
text.19:66: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
text.19:67: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
text.21:37: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
text.22:66: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate.
text.23:12: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
text.25:29: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
text.25:49: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.
text.27:56: But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!
text.29:8: We have enjoined on man kindness to parents; but if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what ye used to do.
text.31:14: And We have enjoined upon man concerning his partners - His mother beareth him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years - Give thanks unto Me and unto thy parents. Unto Me is the journeying.
text.32:7: Who made all things good which He created, and He began the creation of man from clay;
text.33:72: Lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! he hath proved a tyrant and a fool.
text.36:77: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
text.39:8: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.
text.39:49: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not.
text.41:49: Man tireth not of praying for good, and if ill toucheth him, then he is disheartened, desperate.
text.41:51: When We show favour unto man, he withdraweth and turneth aside, but when ill toucheth him then he aboundeth in prayer.
text.42:48: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate.
text.43:15: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
text.46:15: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
text.50:16: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
text.53:24: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
text.53:39: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
text.55:14: He created man of clay like the potter's,
text.59:16: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
text.75:3: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
text.75:5: But man would fain deny what is before him.
text.75:10: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
text.75:13: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
text.75:14: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
text.75:36: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
text.76:1: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
text.76:2: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
text.79:35: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
text.82:6: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
text.84:6: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
text.86:5: So let man consider from what he is created.
text.89:15: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
text.89:23: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
text.90:4: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
text.95:4: Surely We created man of the best stature
text.96:5: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
text.96:6: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
text.99:3: And man saith: What aileth her?
text.100:6: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
text.103:2: Lo! man is a state of loss,
